title: Freya and the Garden
author: Sable Okonkwo
blurb: Ulyana Pemberton, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
